desc:
🎤 Live voice karaoke. A new song every round: press GRAB THE MIC, and if the draw picks you, the stage is yours.

🦃 THANKSGIVING: a new room, THE LAST SUPPER. One long table above the city: pull up a chair and sing.

🎶 270+ songs with lyrics on screen
⭐ The room rates every singer 1 to 5 stars and reacts live
🎟️ Your chance at the mic grows with every song you wait
🏆 Earn Stars, climb tonight's Top Singers board, unlock mic effects, stage effects and titles
🛋️ MY STAGE: build the stage you sing on
🎙️ Players record covers that play in the game

MODES
🎭 Theater: 16-song shows with a final
☕ Hangout: small rooms, you pick the songs
➕ 18+ servers and Competitive servers

Voice chat is needed to sing. Everyone can watch, rate and react.
